title: Survival Science
description:
S01 E01 — Surviving a Bear Attack
Nick and Laura create tests to explore the immense power and startling speed of grizzly bears; they use Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack and then try to recreate a miracle arrow shot that saved a man from being killed by a bear.

title: Survival Science
description:
S01 E02 — Surviving Treestand Accidents
Finding out the reasons why tree stand accidents happen and how one can prevent them; cool science mixed with dynamic experiments send the hosts, stunt team and special crash test dummies plummeting to the ground.

title: Survival Science
description:
S01 E03 — Sniper Attack
In addition to marksmanship and long-range shooting, military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition.

title: Re:Think
description:
S01 E01 — Penrose Triangle and The Brain Illusion Pareidolia
A look at impossible objects such as the Penrose triangle and the brain illusion pareidolia; explores the phenomenon of levitation.

title: Re:Think
description:
S01 E02 — The Magic of Newtonian Fluids
Explains optical illusions like forced perspective, introduces the magic of Newtonian fluids, and an in-depth look at the magic bed of nails trick.

title: Re-Think
description:
S01 E03 — Ambigram, Grandfather Paradox, Shepard Tone Illusion, Density Cocktail, Rethinkers
A second look discovering the weird, quaint, and downright bizarre.

Steve shows more experiments that can be done in a garage; Steve plays "Will It Float?"; lifting a car with a plastic bag.

title: Xploration DIY Sci

New ways to create art using science; a walking pizza box that delivers itself.

title: Xploration DIY Sci
description:

title: Suppressed Science
description:
S01 E01 — Merging Man & Machine
Athena links herself to a robot hand endowed with a delicate sense of touch and gets a sneak peek at unreleased consumer products which promise to optimize our brainwaves.

title: Suppressed Science
description:

title: Bright Now!

title: More Curious?
description:

Take a ride through the history of the roller skate, explore the ancient art of baking, and find out more about the versatile bamboo plant and its many uses, from medicine to musical instruments.

title: More Curious?
description:
S01 E02 — Chopsticks, Coffee and Coins
Find out about chopsticks, coffee, coins, cooking, and cotton, explore the various dinosaurs, and what it's like to feel and prepare for an earthquake.

title: More Curious?
description:
S01 E03 — What Do Karate and Kickboxing Have in Common?
The science of fossils and features of modern gyms are explored; covering induction cooking and similarities between karate and kickboxing.

title: Silly Sustainability
description:

Andy from the YouTube channel "How To Make Everything" tests if he can use clippings from mowing his lawn to create fuel that powers the very lawnmower he uses to do so.

title: Silly Sustainability
description:

title: Science of Sound
description:

Marty Music sits down with Dr. Carole Scherling, a neuroscientist from Belmont University, to talk all about sticky lyrics and the science behind why some catchy tunes get stuck in audience's heads.

title: Future Warfare
description:
S01 E01
Artificial intelligence and autonomy are no longer just the realm of science fiction; they are a key part of the fourth industrial revolution.

description:

Space is home to crucial resources, important discoveries, and big potential profit; examining whether outer space could become a place where billionaires and mega-corporations operate above and out of the reach of the law.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E02 — Sol Ownership: Can a Corporation Own the Sun?
Human needs have always created opportunities for human greed; energy might be the most crucial need of all; if, one day, an ambitious corporation was able to control the sun, could there end up being a subscription fee for sunlight?

description:

One of the world's largest and highest profile civil engineering works tries to save Venice, Italy, from inundation.

title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction?
description:
S01 E01 — Shark Go Boom
In an iconic scene, Chief Brody hangs onto his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth; constructing a giant shark on a motorized platform to test if a person can hit, and explode, the tank.

title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction?
description:
S01 E03 — The Good, The Bad and Terry
In a classic western, Clint Eastwood -- aka Blondie -- saves Eli Wallach from the hangman's noose three separate times by shooting and severing the rope that he hangs from; recreating each scene and testing the reality of those shots.

title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction?
description:
S01 E04 — Dying Hard
John McClane (Bruce Willis) finds himself dangling from the side of a building and must shoot through the glass window to break through to safety; reconstructing the scene using the same Beretta 92 handgun and office glass.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S01 E04 — Life Beyond Earth
SETI searches for intelligent life in the universe; top candidates to host life beyond Earth.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S01 E05 — Asteroids
Asteroids and their potential impact on Earth; an asteroid may have killed off the dinosaurs; the Chelyabinsk meteor of 2013; predicting impact size on the moon and the Earth; valuable materials in asteroids.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S01 E06 — Space Balloons
Creating and testing high-altitude balloons to survive the rigors of near space; a balloon lifts an 8,000-pound telescope to the edge of space and discovers something amazing; a dramatic search-and-rescue mission.

title: The Lightbulb Moment
description:
S01 E02 — Cubicle: How the Cubicle Became Universally Hated
The Cubicle was originally designed to set workers free; a futuristic designer named Robert Propst dreamed up the cubicle as a groovy 1960s workplace utopia that would unleash the modern knowledge worker's vast untapped potential.

title: Bright Now!
description:
S01 E12 — Hacking Our Microbiome
New science reveals what 40 trillion non-human microorganisms hosted by each person do and how understanding them can help people live healthier lives.

Learning about future of living at the International Furniture Fair Cologne: vertical cities, new housing concepts and home innovations.

Check the future of communication and satellite connection to the internet in all parts of the world, especially on cruise ships.

Artificial satellites contribute to life on Earth through their use in communications, weather observation, global positioning and resource management.

John Rambo's ability to decimate enemies all by himself has created some of the most incredible weapon stunts in Hollywood history; testing the reality surrounding these iconic scenes from this blockbuster franchise.

description:
S01 E06 — Terry and The Minigun
Can you really fire a GE Minigun handheld with ammunition held in a backpack (also seen on Captain America: Winter Soldier)? Additionally, for one of our larger tests - can you actually chop down a jungle forest with a minigun?

description:

Using a unique method to crack a safe, Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) uses a blowtorch to cut through a safe, fill it with water, and blow the door off using a small explosive device; the show tests this, along with the effects of a 20mm antitank rifle.

The moon; teams competing for the Google Lunar X Prize; returning to the moon.

Massoud Hassani has developed the Mine Kafon drone that could find and get rid of the landmines quickly and cheaply.

description:

A family of sperm whales in the Indian Ocean.

description:
